parts.title: Classify by use and role
parts.body: The EU AI Act assigns obligations according to the use case and whether an organization provides or deploys a system. Inventory each EU use, check prohibited practices, possible high-risk categories, transparency duties, and any general-purpose model role. Review the European Commission's live implementation page before setting dates because applicability and proposed amendments evolve. Keep GDPR analysis separate where personal data is processed.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Do a cross-region review
parts.body: A recruitment tool used in Paris and Toronto needs an EU AI Act role and risk assessment for the EU deployment. Its personal data use also needs a GDPR review. For Canada, identify applicable federal or provincial privacy law and whether a public-sector automated decision directive applies. Log each jurisdiction and the accountable counsel; do not apply the Canadian federal government directive to all private employers.
parts.label: Apply
